name: Kimi to Koete Yuku 2
source:
This game is "Visual Novels".
Boy Rise's growing and love story.
Rise loves boys and girls.

※This game is a sequel to "Go beyond together with you 1".
※All texts are in Japanese.
[Source: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/go-beyond-together-with-you-2/id1234076447]
